resources.string: Offline guide to Shizuku, Quick Settings tiles and rear screen features
Tap a chapter to view its steps. This guide works offline.

Install and open Shizuku. On non-rooted Android 11 or later, connect to Wi-Fi and follow its instructions to enable Wireless debugging in Developer options. On Xiaomi, also enable USB debugging (Security settings) if ADB access is restricted.\nIn Wireless debugging, choose pairing with a pairing code, then enter that code in the Shizuku pairing notification. Return to Shizuku, tap Start and confirm the service is running. Pairing alone does not start the service.\nFor other startup methods, follow the instructions in Shizuku. After rebooting a non-rooted device, start Shizuku again, then open ReMRSS.

Open ReMRSS and authorize Shizuku on the Rear screen page. Wait for the top connection status to confirm the control service is connected before switching screens or changing display settings.\nOpen About → Permission checks to see each permission and its purpose. Rear notifications need Notification access; floating recording controls need Display over other apps; installing unknown apps is only needed when installing updates.\nUse Grant access or Open settings for a missing permission, follow the system prompt and return. Grant only what your chosen features need.

Start Shizuku and authorize ReMRSS, then use the three buttons below to add tiles directly. Their appearance follows the system Control center. If direct addition is unavailable, edit Control center or Quick Settings to add ReMRSS’s Switch to rear screen, Rear screen screenshot and Rear screen recording tiles manually.\nOpen the app you want on the main screen, expand Quick Settings and tap Switch to rear screen. Keep the panel open while the service is connecting; closing it before the operation starts can cancel the request.\nTo return the app to the main screen, tap its running-on-rear-screen notification. With proximity detection enabled, you can also use the cover detection described on the Rear screen page. If the rear screen is occupied, return that app before casting another.

Direct casting is the default. Enable Virtual rear casting on the Rear screen page to use the virtual mode for tiles and automation. It requires Android 13 or later and supported rear-screen hardware. Changes apply to the next cast; stop the current cast before starting again.
In virtual mode, swipe inward from the right edge to go back. Pause after swiping in; when the icon changes to a menu, release to exit, rotate or switch between the full area and camera avoidance. Orientation and area are remembered per app.
Density compatibility appears only in virtual mode and is off for every app by default. Virtual casting and edge gestures still work when all app switches are off. Enable it for an app to improve layout and local scaling, then optionally set its layout DPI from 72 to 640. The default is 200; lower values fit more content. Enabled apps appear first. Changes apply to the next cast.
Unlock the main screen to start casting, then you can lock it and continue using the rear screen. Stopping restores the previous state without changing the target app battery settings. Unlock first if a new cast cannot start while locked.

With the desired content on the rear screen, tap the screenshot tile. Images are saved in Pictures/RearDisplay. The tile and {scheme}://screenshot share the settings in Rear screen → Rear-screen screenshots.\nFor device frames, enable Add device frame, choose the full device or close-up composition and a color, and optionally keep the original image too. Black, white, purple and green frames are available for Xiaomi 17 Pro / 17 Pro Max. The first download needs internet; cached frames work offline. If a frame is unavailable or processing fails, the original is saved with a message.\nTap the recording tile to open floating controls. First allow Display over other apps. Tap the red circle to start, then the square to stop. Videos are saved in Movies. Close the controls after stopping, or tap the recording tile again. Device frames apply to screenshots only.

With virtual casting off, Rear-screen display provides physical rear-screen DPI and 0°, 90°, 180° and 270° rotation. Use the actual state reported after a change. This group is hidden in virtual mode: adjust virtual app size in Density compatibility and rotate content from the rear-screen menu. Switching modes keeps saved settings.\nKeep Screen On applies while an app is cast; Always Wake Up applies when no app is cast. Proximity detection can return a cast app when the sensor is covered. These controls remain available in both modes.\nCharging animation appears when power is connected. Enable Keep charging animation on for continuous display while charging. Consider battery use and screen burn-in when displaying static content for a long time.

Open the Alerts tab, enable the notification service and grant Notification access. Permission to send this app’s notifications does not grant access to notifications from other apps.\nOpen the notification app list and select the sources you need. Configure hidden titles/content, system Do Not Disturb, the face-down condition and auto-dismiss time as needed.\nIf no notification appears, confirm the source app posted a new notification, then check your selected apps, Do Not Disturb, face-down condition and Notification access. Review permissions and background settings in About → Permission checks.

For manual tile use, a Recents lock is usually unnecessary. For ongoing notifications, charging animations or keep-awake features, allow background operation and review autostart and battery restrictions.\nPermission checks reports Android battery optimization exemption. Xiaomi’s Unrestricted app battery policy is a separate setting. Check autostart and vendor battery policy manually. ReMRSS is hidden from Recents and needs no dedicated lock.\nAllowing autostart does not restore every feature after reboot. Start Shizuku, then open ReMRSS. Check updates manually from About → Check for updates, and allow unknown-app installation only when needed to install an update.

If asked to start Shizuku, check that its service is running. If asked to authorize the app, review Shizuku authorization in Permission checks. After a connection timeout, expand Quick Settings again and retry.
If the rear screen is occupied or content disappears, return the cast app to the main screen before casting again. For missing notifications or charging animations, review their switches, trigger conditions, background restrictions and Shizuku status.
Automation is available in About → Automation. For example, {scheme}://switch?current=1 casts the current app. If another installed app handles the same scheme, specify ReMRSS’s target package in your automation tool.
For further investigation, open About → Diagnostics for connection details, or use Report an issue with the device, system version, steps and observed behavior.

Adapted from Mrss 使用教程 for the current ReMRSS interface. Original illustrated guide: 汐木泽 and 物博. Original app author: AntiOblivionis. The source includes older interfaces; viewing it online requires an internet connection.
